  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined

  excerpt: Shrinking preserves generated constraints or records a residual rejection.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-5
  excerpt_start_line: 89
  excerpt: The generated campaign runner owns execution, explicit-discard accounting, and conclusion, returns a
    typed terminal result, and rejects campaigns below either configured coverage floor or above the explicit-discard
    ceiling; exhausted searches retain their reason and any missed floor without becoming a completed floor failure.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-6
  excerpt_start_line: 90
  excerpt: Integer and generated Boolean harness campaign cases bind exact values to executable accepted/rejected
    expectations; enum cases execute an all-admitted membership expectation.
- id: FR-002-AC-7
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-7
  excerpt_start_line: 91
  excerpt: PLANNED (IR-815). For one precondition and one postcondition selected from an admitted `CheckedPackageV2`,
    the generated harness embeds each selected clause's FR-014 V2 clause oracle.
- id: FR-002-AC-8
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-8
  excerpt_start_line: 92
  excerpt: PLANNED (IR-815). In the V2 harness, an instrumented snapshot, precondition oracle, subject and postcondition
    oracle record that the snapshot precedes precondition evaluation, which precedes subject invocation, which precedes
    postcondition evaluation, for every case.
- id: FR-002-AC-9
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-9
  excerpt_start_line: 93
  excerpt: PLANNED (IR-815). Source inspection shows the V2 harness generator opens a `CheckedPackageV2` body only
    through the `core/ir/` layer of AD-004, and names no `BoundPackage`, `ClauseRef`, `quire_contract_model::TypedExpression`
    or `oracle::boolean_v1` item, each of which today's V1 harness names or uses.
- id: FR-002-AC-10
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-10
  excerpt_start_line: 94
  excerpt: PLANNED (IR-815). A selected clause identity that is unknown, of the wrong clause kind, or the same for

- id: FR-002-AC-11
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined

  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496

    diagnostic and no artifact, and the generator emits no filtering strategy for it.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002-AC-12
  excerpt_start_line: 96

    and campaign policy is byte-identical. The requirement and revision identity that the generated header, `RequirementId`
    and symbols carry is not an input here and waits on OQ-1.
- id: FR-002-AC-13
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md

  anchor: FR-002-AC-13

    pass.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: examined

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md

- id: FR-008-AC-1
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md

  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-1
  excerpt_start_line: 117
  excerpt: A fresh QSL-produced, IR-admitted ConfigVersion V2 postcondition with direct `self.versionNumber = pre(self.versionNumber)`
    yields two `State` census entries in authored order, `Post` then `Pre`, each 0..=1000, with the same project
    id, `quire.op.integer.eq`, and the selected clause and authentic claim retained. The let-bound alias form yields
    a typed operand refusal and no bundle.
- id: FR-008-AC-2
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-2
  excerpt_start_line: 118
  excerpt: An IR-admitted V2 `amount < 7` invariant with a typed current read of range 0..=1000 yields operator
    `Less`, primary `amount`, literal 7 and that inclusive census domain. Reversing the two authored operands preserves
    the reversed positions and corresponding operator semantics.
- id: FR-008-AC-3
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-3
  excerpt_start_line: 119
  excerpt: A valid selected comparison generates despite a comparison-oracle-refused sibling claim in the same package;
    requesting the refused claim returns its typed selected-claim cause and locus with no bundle. An oracle-construction
    failure for the selected claim returns no bundle. Each of integer.eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge has an executable selected-claim
    comparison oracle whose result agrees with the ordered relation and generated tags. Arithmetic, alias, Boolean
    and literal-only shapes refuse at their own structural loci.
- id: FR-008-AC-4
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-4
  excerpt_start_line: 120
  excerpt: Unknown clause, absent claim, unsupported clause kind and malformed comparison report distinct typed
    causes in the stated first-defect order. Diagnostics carry selected clause and claim, structural path and reached
    child id when available, without claiming a unique child source region.
- id: FR-008-AC-5
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-5
  excerpt_start_line: 121
  excerpt: A request with several applicable defects returns the first only. Every refusal returns zero artifacts;
    a successful request returns the complete source, census and runner bundle.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-6
  excerpt_start_line: 122
  excerpt: Either read endpoint or a literal at i64::MIN - 1, i64::MAX + 1, i128::MIN or i128::MAX refuses `UnsupportedRelation`
    at that operand without narrowing. Two individually i64-representable reads with unequal ranges also refuse;
    equal ranges admit when other rules hold.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-7
  excerpt_start_line: 123
  excerpt: PLANNED. Beyond the per-operator agreement stated in FR-008-AC-3, which this criterion does not repeat,
    for each of integer.eq, ne, lt, le, gt and ge the selected claim's V2 comparison oracle returns, for every valuation
    of a 1- to 4-member domain (read-versus-read and read-versus-literal, the literal at each member and in either
    authored position), the result of an independently evaluated ordered relation.

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-8
  excerpt_start_line: 124

  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-9

  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-AC-10
  excerpt_start_line: 126

    no body JSON (the verification of FR-008-CON-1).

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008-CON-1
  excerpt_start_line: 108
  excerpt: The generator SHALL read V2 operand identity, provenance, observation, operator and bounds only through

  anchor: FR-008-CON-2

  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion

- id: FR-009-AC-1
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-009-AC-1
  excerpt_start_line: 71
  excerpt: For the QSL-produced, IR-admitted V2 `VersionUnchanged` selected claim (FR-008-AC-1) over 0..=1000, every
    `Satisfying` case has post = pre, every `Violating` case has post ≠ pre, and every value lies in 0..=1000.
- id: FR-009-AC-2
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-009-AC-2
  excerpt_start_line: 72
  excerpt: 'For every V2 comparison operator, every domain of 1, 2, 3, and 4 members, and both a two-read relation
    and a read-versus-literal relation with the literal at each domain member, the generatable set of each population
    equals the independently enumerated satisfying or violating set: none missing, none extra. An empty side is
    refused with `EmptyPopulation` and never produces an empty strategy.'

  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-009-AC-3

  excerpt: Generated population source contains no filter, assume, reject, or discard call, and a seeded 10,000-case

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion

  anchor: FR-009-AC-5

  excerpt: A domain of `i64::MIN..=i64::MAX` with `NotEqual`, `Less`, and `Equal` compiles as generated Rust and

  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-009-AC-6

  excerpt: Repeated generation for the same `CheckedPackageV2`, selected clause id, authentic claim occurrence,

- id: FR-009-AC-7
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: examined
  unit_type: acceptance_criterion

- id: AD-001
  path: spec/assurance/AD-001-codegen-architecture.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: AD-001
  excerpt_start_line: 32
  excerpt: 'The code generator turns an admitted contract package into Rust oracles, property-test harnesses,

    bounded Kani obligations and their evidence, runs one Kani obligation on the installed backend,

    and hands every counterexample to QSL for native replay. It is the Kani backend adapter of the

    AD-016 pipeline: it selects the runtime operation per IR node at arrow 3, settles capabilities at

    arrow 4''s single negotiation point and generates oracles there, generates harnesses at arrow 5, and

    owns the execution half of arrow 6 and the reconstruction half of arrow 7.'
- id: AD-002
  path: spec/assurance/AD-002-cg-qsl-replay-seam.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: AD-002
  excerpt_start_line: 24
  excerpt: 'The Replay subsystem row of the Subsystem Registry lists this AD beside AD-001. It is a view of

    one boundary of AD-001''s "CG to QSL" seam rows, not a second architecture, and it is one of the

    seam descriptions of IR-324. The evidence chain that joins this seam to IR and to the terminal

    value is [AD-003](AD-003-evidence-chain.md).'
- id: AD-003
  path: spec/assurance/AD-003-evidence-chain.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: AD-003
  excerpt_start_line: 32
  excerpt: 'This AD governs the Kani and Evidence subsystems and the Replay subsystem''s identity members. CG

    owns it because CG is the one repository that depends on both IR and QSL; IR must not depend on

    QSL, so no other repository can join the chain. IR and QSL each hold their own link and are cited,

    not copied. It is one of the seam descriptions of IR-324.'
- id: AD-004
  path: spec/assurance/AD-004-cg-crate-layout.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: AD-004
  excerpt_start_line: 34
  excerpt: 'AD-001 states what the generator is and which seams it has. This AD states how `src/` is cut so

    that the code matches the subsystems in the Subsystem Registry of [spec.md](../spec.md): the

    directory tree, which module goes where, which way imports may point, and what is deleted. It is

    the design that IR-348 implements. It describes this repository only. Seams to IR, RT and QSL are

    AD-001''s. The replay seam (AD-002) and the evidence chain (AD-003) are the seam descriptions of

    IR-324; both are merged, and this AD references them.'
- id: AD-005
  path: spec/assurance/AD-005-source-obligation-producer.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: AD-005
  excerpt_start_line: 24
  excerpt: 'This AD defines the planned [FR-036](../evidence/functional/FR-036-source-obligation-census.md)

    CG producer seam. The source owners supply selected inventories and authored mappings;

    CG exports their complete census and actual producer facts. IR FR-045/AD-008 own

    eligibility, joins, proof credit and the four accounting projections. The driver or

    another adapter above both owners connects the borrowed exports to IR accounting.

    This seam adds no solver, production-source parser or assurance verdict.'
- id: FR-005
  path: spec/core/functional/FR-005-cli-conformance.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-005
  excerpt_start_line: 19
  excerpt: 'When invoked through the library or CLI, the generator shall write a complete artifact bundle

    atomically and shall retain differential and cross-backend semantic-parity results.'
- id: FR-037
  path: spec/core/functional/FR-037-fixture-identity.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-037
  excerpt_start_line: 19
  excerpt: 'When the exact-scalar or composite-equality fixture builder assigns a candidate

    identity to an application-bodied checked-package node, the builder shall use

    Contract IR''s `derive_application_node_id` with an `ApplicationNodeDraft` made

    from that node. For a grouped node, it shall supply an

    `ApplicationIdentityContext` made from the complete, ordered draft graph. The

    builder shall use the resulting candidate node ID for fixture assembly and

    retain the checked-package reader as the admission authority. It shall not

    construct or hash a local copy of the application preimage or its version tag.'
- id: FR-038
  path: spec/core/functional/FR-038-typed-operator-catalog.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-038
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: "When a V2 oracle or Kani generator selects an operation from an IR-admitted\nchecked-package claim,\
    \ Contract Codegen shall resolve its catalogued identity\nthrough one internal, closed typed operator source.\
    \ That source shall describe\nthe operation family, operand arity and order, result kind, and applicable\nrendering\
    \ metadata without becoming an authority for IR admission or inventing\nan identity absent from the upstream\
    \ verification catalog. Each consumer shall\nselect only the operations it can render and shall retain its existing\
    \ typed\n  refusal or unsupported disposition for an admitted but "
- id: FR-039
  path: spec/core/functional/FR-039-contract-package-consumption.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-039
  excerpt_start_line: 29
  excerpt: 'When the driver submits a complete-V1 request for production negotiation or

    generation, this generator SHALL base every decision about its selected IR

    meaning on the one admitted QSpec FR-330 `ContractPackage` emitted for that

    request. Contract IR owns its lowering and sole strict reader; CG consumes the

    typed admitted value and does not define another package schema or reader.'

  excerpt: "- Every generated Rust file shall have a header naming `quire-contract-codegen` and every\n  input-carried\
    \ generation subject identity it renders, as defined in Scope.\n- Where the generation input carries a requirement,\
    \ revision or clause identifier, the generated\n  Rust file header shall name it.\n- Generated Rust shall carry\
    \ `MIT OR Apache-2.0` SPDX identity.\n- No automated output shall claim project-specific validation, accreditation,\
    \ certification, or human release approval."
- id: NFR-005
  path: spec/core/non-functional/NFR-005-no-generation-panics.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: NFR-005
  excerpt_start_line: 22
  excerpt: "- The generator's production code under `src/` shall contain no panic token: no `unwrap`, `expect`,\n\
    \  `unreachable!`, `assert!` or any other call FR-014-AC-39 lists, so that no panic token aborts the\n  generator\
    \ instead of a typed refusal.\n- The sites of the four IR-577 behavior-table rows (in `generate_kani`,\n  `observe_clause`\
    \ and `generate_boolean_oracle_inner`) shall not index, slice or subtract on a\n  value that an earlier function\
    \ establishes.\n- Each of those sites shall read the value with a checked accessor (`get`, a slice pattern,\n\
    \  `checked_sub`, or a value built before it is stored)"
- id: StR-001
  path: spec/core/stakeholder/StR-001-traceable-generation.md

  unit_type: section
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: Stakeholder Need
  excerpt_start_line: 49
  excerpt: 'Assurance engineers require that the generator shall derive executable, property-test, proof, and

    coverage artifacts reproducibly from one validated contract without hiding unsupported semantics,

    vacuity, rejection, or assumptions.'

  anchor: ADR-006
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'Proposed. The caller admission oracle and Kani route are unimplemented;

    [FR-035](../oracle/functional/FR-035-caller-text-admission.md) and

    [TC-050](../oracle/matrix/TC-050-caller-text-admission.md) are Planned, not

- id: FR-004
  path: spec/evidence/functional/FR-004-vacuity-evidence.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-004
  excerpt_start_line: 19
  excerpt: 'When LLVM/cargo coverage export and runtime campaign counts are supplied, the generator shall combine

    oracle evaluation, consequent execution, rejection, discard, and test outcome into a deterministic

    per-requirement vacuity report without executing a coverage producer itself.'

    selected obligation inventory, all explicitly mapped criterion-obligation-source-domain

- id: FR-015
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-015-bounded-kani-obligations.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-015
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'When a caller selects Kani generation for complete-V1 contracts whose scalar

    oracles FR-014 generated, the code generator shall emit one bounded Kani

    obligation per precondition, postcondition, invariant and frame condition,

    each bounded by its model-domain bounds. It is the Kani

    backend''s one generator

    ([ADR-001](../../decisions/ADR-001-overlapping-generators-and-input-models.md)),

    and every item it lowers is a claim over an admitted `quire.checked-package/v2`

    package.'
- id: FR-017
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-017-kani-execution-evidence.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-017
  excerpt_start_line: 23
  excerpt: 'When a caller runs an FR-015, FR-022/FR-014 or FR-035 harness, the code generator shall invoke the

    installed Kani backend and retain the backend''s own reported outcome as typed

    execution evidence. A caller may hand the generator several harnesses to run together

    (FR-017-AC-21 to FR-017-AC-25); the generator then forms groups, runs each

    group in one launcher process, and retains one evidence record per harness. Unless a

    statement says "batch" or "group", it describes a run of one harness.'
- id: FR-025
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-025-generated-subject-abi.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-025
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'When the code generator emits an [FR-015](./FR-015-bounded-kani-obligations.md) harness, it shall

    emit the harness''s symbolic arguments in the order of the obligation identity''s `arguments`, which

    ascend by identifier. Each argument binding names its parameter node id and declared domain, each

    argument has the Rust type its family''s row below states, and each argument reaches the generated

    oracle widened into the complete-V1 value type without loss.'
- id: FR-028
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-028-bounded-proof-ceilings.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-028
  excerpt_start_line: 25
  excerpt: 'The code generator shall bound every Kani harness so that its run can finish: each harness identity

    records a memory ceiling and a wall-clock ceiling, a run that exceeds either settles `inconclusive`

    with its own reason, and the evidence records the bounds and ceilings the run used. Proof coverage

    is maximised per family. A family proves the production code where its harness verifies within the

    ceilings, and a bounded shadow together with a refinement obligation where it does not

    ([ADR-003](../../decisions/ADR-003-kani-tractability.md)).'
- id: FR-029
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-029-run-outcome-terminal-record.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-029
  excerpt_start_line: 25
  excerpt: 'The Kani adapter shall map every `KaniRunOutcome`, with its inconclusive reason or typed

    cancellation source, paired with the settlement of that run''s replay, to QSL''s FR-331 terminal

    value (`qsl_replay::TerminalValue`) in

    one match with no catch-all arm ([ADR-002](../../decisions/ADR-002-backend-adapter-boundary.md)

    Q3). The map is total over the pair (outcome, replay settlement), not over the outcome alone: a

    falsified run''s value is a function of both, because a counterexample is a refutation only once its

    replay reproduces it. Every pair maps to exactly one terminal value, so every run ite'
- id: FR-030
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-030-ir-outcome-terminal-map.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-030
  excerpt_start_line: 27
  excerpt: 'The generator shall map every Contract IR `KaniOutcome`, paired with the settlement of its replay, to

    exactly one `qsl_replay::TerminalValue`. The map is total over the pair (outcome, replay

    settlement), not over the outcome alone, and it preserves the outcome''s refusal cause: the outcome

    kinds that QSL''s terminal value collapses into one variant stay distinguishable through that

    variant''s typed cause. This is QSL ADR-013 C-09 as merged, whose two inputs are the IR `KaniOutcome`

    and, for a `Counterexample`, the result of its replay. The replay settlement, its six readings and

    the rules that cl'
- id: FR-034
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-034-caller-death-ownership.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-034
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'If the original caller dies, then the namespace guardian shall cancel its backend descendants. The

    guardian shall prevent startup EOF from authorizing a production backend instruction.'
- id: FR-040
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-040-cancellation-producer.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-040
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'When a caller requests cancellation of a bounded Kani execution, the generator SHALL observe the

    caller-owned `quire_exact::Cancel` handle at the real launcher and retain the cause of the first

    cancellation event that stops that launcher. The caller owns the handle and any timer: a timer can

    call `cancel(CancelCause::Deadline)`, while an elapsed [FR-028](./FR-028-bounded-proof-ceilings.md)

    execution ceiling without a recorded cancellation event remains `TimedOut`. This requirement adds

    one producer path to [FR-017](./FR-017-kani-execution-evidence.md); it does not treat a Contract IR

    outcome r'
- id: FR-041
  path: spec/kani/functional/FR-041-claimed-module-proof-gate.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-041
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'When the repository claims proof coverage for a generated-harness module, its existing

    [`make kani-gate`](../non-functional/NFR-006-real-kani-lane-gating.md) SHALL accept that claim only

    after a real Kani run discharges a proposition in the module and an executed mutation inside the

    module falsifies a proof check. The gate applies the proof-stage acceptance rule of QSL ADR-011

    §2.3 to CG''s claimed modules. It makes no claim about a module absent from its declared list or

    about a semantic stage the test input did not traverse.'

  excerpt: 'When a caller supplies an admitted `quire.checked-package/v2` package and a set

    of equality expression nodes, the code generator shall emit a deterministic Rust

    oracle crate whose functions decide each node by reconstructing the item''s

    `TypeEnvironment` and calling the Contract Runtime

    `TypeEnvironment::check_equality` and `CheckedEquality::evaluate` with a

    caller-supplied `Meter`. It never compares two values structurally, and never

    copies a resource charge or a planned pair count.'
- id: FR-021
  path: spec/oracle/functional/FR-021-function-application-oracles.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-021
  excerpt_start_line: 29
  excerpt: 'When a caller supplies an admitted `quire.checked-package/v2` package, function

    bindings and requested `call` nodes, the generator shall classify the admitted

    expression-node graph, build a deterministic, target-neutral instruction

    schedule for each admitted body, and record one generated or typed-refused

    disposition per item. The schedule preserves V2 operation identity, operand

    order, value/result types, function binding, and source occurrence identity;

    it states no charge amount and executes no operation itself. Its body analysis

    and schedule emission use charged iterative walks and no fixe'
- id: FR-031
  path: spec/oracle/functional/FR-031-boolean-oracle-integer-arithmetic.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-031
  excerpt_start_line: 31
  excerpt: 'The Boolean oracle of `interface-001`''s `oracle_slice` lowers one validated Boolean clause over

    Boolean and bounded-integer values into a Rust function. Its clauses may hold integer add,

    subtract, multiply, divide and remainder, and the six integer comparisons. Today the emitter

    renders each of those five operators as the raw Rust infix operator on `i64`, and each comparison

    as the raw infix comparison. It never reads the operand type''s overflow policy. On overflow the

    generated function panics in a debug build and wraps in a release build, and on a zero divisor it

    panics. The exact kernel''s i'
- id: FR-035
  path: spec/oracle/functional/FR-035-caller-text-admission.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-035
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'When a caller requests runtime Text admission, the code generator shall emit an

    oracle and a separately bounded Kani obligation for a caller-owned

    `TextPayload` and declared `TextType`. This is a caller-ingress claim, not a

    claim about an expression node in an admitted `CheckedPackageV2`. The oracle

    calls the exact kernel''s `quire_exact::admit_text` API and returns its

    outcome and metering unchanged. Its evidence identifies the caller-declared

    profile, inclusive length bounds, payload class and proof configuration,

    without `ir_confirmed` provenance, a checked node id or a QSL term identity.'

    Boolean, equality, function and pre-check placeholder constructor.

    CG''s boundary and not claimed by CG (FR-014-AC-47); generated-oracle against QSL agreement is owned by quire-integration

  path: spec/replay/functional/FR-016-witness-native-replay.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-016
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'When a FR-015 harness yields a counterexample, the code generator shall decode

    the witness into typed complete-V1 values, validate each value against its

    declared domain, and replay it through native runtime execution before any

    failure is reported.'
- id: FR-024
  path: spec/replay/functional/FR-024-counterexample-envelope-intake.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-024
  excerpt_start_line: 31
  excerpt: 'When a counterexample is to be replayed, the code generator shall carry it to QSL as QSL''s

    counterexample envelope (`qsl_replay::WitnessEnvelope`), keyed by QSL''s `ObligationIdentity` and

    holding exactly one `qsl_replay::ReplaySource` arm. It shall validate every value against its

    declared domain before any replay, and shall replay only through `qsl_replay::replay`, or through

    `qsl_replay::replay_frame` for a frame counterexample, or through

    `qsl_replay::replay_state_clause` for a postcondition state-clause counterexample.'
- id: FR-032
  path: spec/replay/functional/FR-032-routed-scalar-replay-binding.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-032
  excerpt_start_line: 31
  excerpt: 'When the driver requests replay of a routed scalar counterexample, CG shall bind the request

    directly to its `ScalarObligationIdentity`, preserving the arithmetic-parity proposition the

    actual generated harness checked. This requirement owns a public request builder and a public

    settlement converter; the driver owns the intervening QSL replay call. QSL owns the operator-level

    exact evaluation, envelope arm, evidence and terminal causes.'

  path: spec/replay/functional/FR-033-composite-parity-replay-binding.md

- id: FR-019
  path: spec/routed/functional/FR-019-capability-settlement.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-019
  excerpt_start_line: 47
  excerpt: 'When a backend provider envelope requests claims of this generator, the

    generator shall settle each requested item at exactly one point, a `negotiate_*`

    arm over a closed backend kind, and shall settle no capability anywhere else.'
- id: FR-022
  path: spec/routed/functional/FR-022-routed-generation.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-022
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'When the orchestrating driver hands this generator the items that FR-019

    settled `supported` and that QSL `route` then routed, each with its request

    index, its routed backend and that backend''s closed backend kind, together

    with one admitted IR `ContractPackageV1` and the complete lowering-position

    mapping, the generator shall run the

    generation arm of each item''s backend kind and return that arm''s output keyed

    by the item''s request index. It shall not settle, select or route a backend

    again.'
- id: FR-026
  path: spec/routed/functional/FR-026-backend-adapter-contract.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-026
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'The code generator shall hold everything specific to one linked proof backend in that backend''s adapter,

    one implementation of a single adapter trait, and shall reach an adapter only through an exhaustive

    match on the closed `BackendKind` enum

    ([ADR-002](../../decisions/ADR-002-backend-adapter-boundary.md) Q0, Q1 and Q4). ADR-002 Q4 states how a

    second linked backend registers. `Process(BackendId)` has no CG adapter; the

    driver''s plugin host owns its process adapter (QSL ADR-029 PV-4).'

  excerpt_start_line: 31
  excerpt: 'Verify that every requested capability claim is settled by exactly one

    `negotiate_*` arm over a closed backend kind, that each FR-290 rule settles its

    own row, including whole-envelope refusal for a repeated backend identity.'
- id: TC-033
  path: spec/routed/matrix/TC-033-routed-generation.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document

    arm, keyed by the driver''s request index. It takes the routed backend and kind

    the FR-015 generator returns for the same items.'

  path: spec/routed/matrix/TC-046-process-provider-settlement.md

  excerpt: 'Verify that `Process(BackendId)` settles from the FR-331 manifest''s advertised

    Manifest `bounds` are run-limit defaults and do not set admission maxima.

- id: spec/spec.md
  path: spec/spec.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: source_file
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: spec/spec.md
  excerpt_start_line: 15
  excerpt: 'This specification defines deterministic lowering from a validated contract package into Rust

    oracles, tri-state test harnesses, shaped proptest strategies, Kani obligations and coverage maps. Generated
    artifacts remain traceable to one authoritative source contract.'
- id: FR-002
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-002-tristate-proptest.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-002
  excerpt_start_line: 15
  excerpt: 'When executable pre/post contracts are lowered, the generator shall emit entry-point harnesses and

    proptest strategies that preserve pass, failed postcondition, and rejected precondition outcomes.'
- id: FR-008
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-008
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'For a request selecting one claim of an admitted `CheckedPackageV2`, the generator SHALL use Contract

    IR''s public clause-context integer-comparison operand accessor (IR FR-038-AC-202 through AC-209) to

    admit a direct comparison and derive its exact domains. The generator SHALL return one complete

    strategy bundle or one typed, located refusal; it SHALL NOT generate a partial bundle. This is the

    V2 input contract for the constructive population and campaign behavior of FR-009 through FR-012.

    The IR accessor and its public consumer test are implemented under IR-703 in Contract IR; IR''s

    fresh QSL '
- id: FR-009
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-009-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-009
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'When a selected claim of an admitted `CheckedPackageV2` is admitted by

    [FR-008](./FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md), the generator shall emit proptest populations

    that construct every case directly inside the shared domain and on the requested side of the

    relation. A case is a complete valuation of the claim''s reads, including any `Post` read, and its tag

    is the value the selected claim''s V2 comparison oracle (FR-008) returns for that valuation. The

    generator never draws a candidate and then filters it out.'
- id: FR-010
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-010-domain-boundary-campaigns.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-010
  excerpt_start_line: 17
  excerpt: 'When a caller requests the `Boundary` population for a selected claim of a `CheckedPackageV2`

    admitted by [FR-008](./FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md), the generator shall emit a finite,

    deterministic census of in-domain cases at the domain edges and the relation''s own edge. Every

    strategy bundle for a selected claim also carries the out-of-domain edge values, so a consumer can

    prove that it refuses them at domain admission. Each in-domain case is tagged with the value the

    selected claim''s V2 comparison oracle (FR-008) returns for it.'
- id: FR-011
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-011-numeric-harness-campaigns.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-011
  excerpt_start_line: 31
  excerpt: 'When a strategy bundle is generated for a selected claim of a `CheckedPackageV2`

    ([FR-008](./FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md)), the generator shall also emit an

    oracle-conformance campaign runner. The runner evaluates the selected claim''s V2 comparison oracle

    on each generated valuation, records the runtime verdict for the checked clause kind, and requires

    that verdict to equal the case''s

    expectation. Its summary reports the discard rate and the rejection rate as exact counts, or as

    unavailable when a counter may be saturated.'
- id: FR-012
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-012-constraint-preserving-shrinking.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-012
  excerpt_start_line: 19
  excerpt: 'When proptest shrinks a failing case drawn from a `Satisfying`, `Violating`, or `Broad` population of

    a selected V2 claim ([FR-008](./FR-008-bound-domain-strategy-admission.md)), every candidate it visits shall
    stay inside the shared domain and keep the expectation tag

    of the case it came from. This refines [FR-002](./FR-002-tristate-proptest.md) FR-002-AC-4 for the

    populations of a selected V2 claim; FR-002-AC-4 itself stays verified by TC-004.'
- id: FR-013
  path: spec/strategy/functional/FR-013-it010-consumable-output.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: FR-013
  excerpt_start_line: 21
  excerpt: 'The generator shall deliver bound strategy, census, and runner output as typed generated Rust, so a

    downstream crate can place every case''s values into its own runtime inputs by typed declaration identity, selected
    path and observation. The generator shall not

    require any serialized case format or schema owned by this repository for that consumption.'
- id: TC-004
  path: spec/strategy/matrix/TC-004-proptest-strategies.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: TC-004
  excerpt_start_line: 13
  excerpt: 'Verify generated harnesses preserve tri-state outcomes and strategy construction/shrinking respects

    supported constraints and boundaries.'
- id: TC-017
  path: spec/strategy/matrix/TC-017-bound-domain-admission.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: TC-017
  excerpt_start_line: 13
  excerpt: 'Verify selected-claim V2 strategy admission through IR''s public clause-context comparison accessor,

    exact domain checks, first-defect diagnostics and atomic bundle output. This case is planned until

    CG''s V2 strategy implementation, V2 comparison oracle and a CG-side real QSL ConfigVersion V2

    producer fixture exist; IR-703''s public accessor is implemented in Contract IR.'
- id: TC-018
  path: spec/strategy/matrix/TC-018-constructive-correlated-populations.md
  role: context_only
  unit_type: document
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: TC-018
  excerpt_start_line: 13
  excerpt: 'Verify that populations for a selected V2 claim (FR-008) are constructed rather than filtered,

    generate exactly the true value sets, refuse empty sides explicitly, and handle `i64` extremes

    without overflow. Every fixture is an IR-admitted `CheckedPackageV2` with a selected clause id and

    authentic claim occurrence; synthetic topology fixtures are labelled and do not stand in for the

  anchor: src/core/identity.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Identity newtypes of a generated Kani harness (AD-004 `core/identity`, L-10).

    //!

    //! A harness is named by a module symbol and a harness symbol, and the two are different kinds of

    //! name: swapping them at a call site must not compile. Each is a validated Rust identifier,

    //! built once where a harness is generated, and [`HarnessPath`] is the pair. They serialize as

    //! the bare string, so a persisted identity record is unchanged, and they deserialize from it

    //! through the same validation.'

  anchor: src/kani/generate/corpus/bounded_kani_corpus.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Integrated bounded-Kani corpus generation over Contract IR''s validated finite ABI.

    //!

    //! CG owns the semantic-family lowerers. This module owns the codegen-side

    //! vertical slice: once one lowering is admitted, it renders the corpus roles (oracle, strategy,

    //! Kani harness, QSL source and dependency, and proof-dependency graph) from the same profile

    //! selection, finite input, and declared proof-dependency census. A non-success outcome returns before any
    role is

    //! emitted.'

  excerpt: '//! Codegen-side admission for Contract IR''s public bounded-Kani profile.

    //!

    //! This boundary consumes Contract IR''s matrix without re-describing semantic families and

    //! returns the complete per-construct disposition census for a request, so a generator can

    //! render an artifact for every construct rather than stopping at the first non-supported one.'

    //! `unsupported` or `invalid_request` (Contract IR FR-036). One `invalid_request` rejects the

    //! whole request and no harness is returned. Otherwise one harness is returned per supported

    //! item and never one for any other disposition.

  excerpt: "pub(crate) fn state_frame_disposition(refusal: StateFrameRefusal) -> ObligationDisposition {\n    use\
    \ BoundNotResolvedCause as Cause;\n    use StateFrameLoweringRefusal as Lowering;\n    let refused = |refusal|\
    \ ObligationDisposition::Unsupported {\n        reason: UnsupportedObligation::StateFrameRefused { refusal },\n\
    \    };\n    let unsupported = |reason| ObligationDisposition::Unsupported { reason };\n    let invalid = |reason|\
    \ ObligationDisposition::InvalidRequest { reason };"

  excerpt: "pub(crate) fn matches_artifact_package(&self, artifacts: &[Artifact]) -> bool {\n        self.has_valid_provenance()\n\

- id: src/kani/output/diagnostics.rs
  path: src/kani/output/diagnostics.rs
  role: examined
  unit_type: source_file
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: src/kani/output/diagnostics.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! The bounded diagnostic record of a run Kani gave no verdict for, or whose CBMC failed (FR-017).

    //!

    //! The record is read from the launcher''s two streams alone. It names the last stage the output

    //! shows a member started and carries a redacted tail of each stream. It never feeds

    //! classification: nothing in this module is consulted until the outcome is already decided.

    //!

    //! The record is serialize-only. The Kani output this module reads is untrusted text, so no

    //! decoder for the record exists.'

  anchor: src/kani/output/playback.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! The concrete-playback block Kani prints on the console.

    //!

    //! Kani''s report carries no concrete playback. The falsifying playback is a Rust unit test Kani

    //! prints on stdout, and [`counterexample_playback`] extracts that one fenced block from the

    //! console text. It reads a payload to hand on verbatim, never a verdict: whether a run

    //! falsified is decided by the report alone, and the block is looked up only after the report

    //! names a failed property check.

    //!

    //! INTERIM: this file also holds the block scan the witness decode reads, and `DecodeFailure`,

    //! the error the scan rai'

  excerpt_start_line: 132
  excerpt: "pub(super) fn observe(&mut self, launcher: u32) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let processes = self.processes(launcher)?;\n\
    \        self.known.retain(|pid, start| {\n            *pid == launcher\n                || processes\n    \
    \                .iter()\n                    .any(|process| process.pid == *pid && process.start == *start)\n\
    \        });"

  anchor: src/kani/run/namespace.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Per-run PID-namespace ownership: gated startup, claimed init, and confirmed teardown.

    //!

    //! Bubblewrap is mandatory. The caller''s process never becomes a subreaper. Before dispatch,

    //! the unreaped monitor pins the dedicated startup process group. After dispatch, the init

    //! pidfd owns every descendant, including orphaned, session-escaped and nested-namespace tasks.

    //!

    //! This ownership and teardown covers in-process conclusions and startup error/unwind paths.

    //! Abrupt caller death (SIGKILL, abort, OOM kill) before the gate/PDEATH chain is fully armed

    //! can close the gate and rel'

  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! The generation-result and claim vocabulary every oracle generator returns.

    //!

    //! Each generator keeps its own item, claim and refusal types, because those

    //! are family-specific. The shapes they share live here once: the

    //! generated-or-refused disposition of one claim, the claim map of one

    //! generation, a whole-generation failure, and the upstream work an item can

    //! be blocked on. A new generator returns these with its own type parameters

    //! and does not edit this module.'

  anchor: src/oracle/equality/mod.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Exact composite/structural equality oracle generation from one admitted

    //! ContractPackage V1 (FR-018, FR-039).

    //!

    //! This is the composite/structural sibling of [`crate::oracle::scalar`]

    //! (FR-014): a requested item names one checked `binary` expression node and a

    //! typed equality descriptor — an operator and two operands, each either

    //! `EqualityOperand::typed(source)` or `EqualityOperand::converted(source,

    //! target)` — where `source`/`target` are named as V2 type node ids, not as

    //! runtime `ValueType` values, because a runtime `ValueType` carries no V2

    //! node id once built'

    //! every declared function''s body into a `Body` closure

    //! (`Fn(&Frame, &[Value]) -> Outcome<Value>`), admits the assembled package

    //! through `PackageDeclarations::check(CheckMode::Linked, limits)`, and emits

    //! one oracle function pe'

  excerpt_start_line: 243
  excerpt: "pub(crate) fn from_ordering_operator(operator: OrderingOperator) -> Option<Self> {\n        match operator\
    \ {\n            OrderingOperator::Less => Some(Self::Less),\n            OrderingOperator::LessOrEqual => Some(Self::LessOrEqual),\n\
    \            OrderingOperator::Greater => Some(Self::Greater),\n            OrderingOperator::GreaterOrEqual\
    \ => Some(Self::GreaterOrEqual),\n            _ => None,\n        }"
  owner_ids: *id056

  anchor: src/oracle/scalar/mod.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Exact complete-V1 scalar oracle generation from CheckedPackage V2 (FR-014).

    //!

    //! The V2 transport names only an operator class (`binary`, `unary`,

    //! `convert`) for a scalar expression, not the operation law. Each request

    //! item therefore pairs a checked node with a typed [`ExactScalarOperation`]

    //! built from Contract Runtime `exact` values, and this module cross-checks

    //! that descriptor against the lowered node before emitting anything.

    //!

    //! Every parameter the node can carry is checked against the IR: the

    //! descriptor''s integer, rational and decimal domains, IEEE rounding '

  anchor: src/replay/function.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! The replay adapter: a decoded Kani falsification goes to QSL''s layer-6 `replay` facade, and

    //! QSL''s own verdict comes back.

    //!

    //! This module builds the backend-witness transcript in the grammar `qsl-replay` admits from the

    //! typed values [`decode_falsification`]

    //! returns, binds each value to its parameter by

    //! the parameter''s node id, and calls [`qsl_replay::replay`]. The executor recompiles the

    //! request''s digest-addressed source and evaluates the selected function itself, so the verdict

    //! is QSL''s, not a value this crate supplies.'

  anchor: src/routed/generate.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! FR-022: generation for items the driver has already settled and routed.

    //!

    //! FR-019 settles a disposition and names a backend kind; QSL `route` picks the backend. This

    //! module is the generation arm of that seam. It takes the routed backend and its kind as given

    //! and runs the kind''s generation arm, dispatched through one exhaustive `match` over

    //! [`BackendKind`] with no catch-all. It takes no manifest, candidate set, extent or capability

    //! kind, so it cannot settle, select or route again, and it builds no FR-019 disposition.

    //!

    //! The Kani arm derives each item''s FR-014 claim'

  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Domain and relation boundary census for one admitted relation (FR-010).

    //!

    //! The census is computed with checked 128-bit arithmetic. An edge value outside `i64` is listed as

    //! an [`UnrepresentableEdge`] rather than clamped, wrapped, or dropped. Generated Rust constants are

    //! the only carrier of the arrays; nothing here serializes a census.'

- id: tests/checked_package_support/rekey.rs
  path: tests/checked_package_support/rekey.rs
  role: examined
  unit_type: source_file
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: tests/checked_package_support/rekey.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! Test-fixture key repair driven by Contract IR''s public candidate API and reader refusals.

    //!

    //! A package builder retains its readable source IDs. This module repairs a copy of its wire,

    //! so building another fixture cannot change IDs observed by a parallel test. The reader remains

    //! the final authority for admission.'
- id: tests/common/byte_ceiling.rs
  path: tests/common/byte_ceiling.rs
  role: examined
  unit_type: source_file
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: tests/common/byte_ceiling.rs
  excerpt_start_line: 1
  excerpt: '//! The byte-ceiling lowering fixtures of FR-014-AC-40, FR-018-AC-20 and FR-021-AC-23.

    //!

    //! Contract IR fails every requested record for `bytes` when the canonical length of the lowered

    //! contract package of a call exceeds the ceiling the checked package was read under. A package

    //! read under such a ceiling must still be admitted, so each fixture measures both lengths and

    //! uses a request set whose per-request accounting makes the lowered package longer. Contract IR

    //! V1 represents each reached graph node only once even when a record has a large closure.'
- id: tests/common/mod.rs
  path: tests/common/mod.rs
  role: examined
  unit_type: source_file
  source_head: 5b207149d64f6e69634c3c1afcb60c94bc4a0496
  anchor: tests/common/mod.rs
